name: idx_siwc_usage_account_timestamp
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_siwc_usage_account_timestamp ON siwc_usage_logs(account_id, timestamp DESC)

name: idx_siwc_usage_user_timestamp
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_siwc_usage_user_timestamp ON siwc_usage_logs(user_id, timestamp DESC)

name: idx_upstream_accounts_status
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_upstream_accounts_status ON upstream_accounts(status, provider)

name: idx_usage_logs_account_timestamp
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_usage_logs_account_timestamp ON usage_logs(upstream_account_id, timestamp DESC)

name: idx_usage_logs_user_timestamp
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_usage_logs_user_timestamp ON usage_logs(user_id, timestamp DESC)

name: account_429_cooldowns
sql:
CREATE TABLE account_429_cooldowns (
  kind TEXT NOT NULL, account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, until_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY(kind, account_id)
)

name: account_daily_reservations
sql:
CREATE TABLE account_daily_reservations (
        account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES upstream_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        day TEXT NOT NULL, used INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(used)='integer' AND used >= 0),
        legacy_ambiguous INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(legacy_ambiguous IN (0,1))
      )

name: account_pool_rules
sql:
CREATE TABLE account_pool_rules (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT,
  provider TEXT,
  model_pattern TEXT NOT NULL,
  
  allowed_account_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
  selection_strategy TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (selection_strategy IN ('round_robin', 'priority', 'least_used')),
  enable_fallback BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: account_quota_migration_marker
sql: CREATE TABLE account_quota_migration_marker (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1))

name: oauth_refresh_intents
sql:
CREATE TABLE oauth_refresh_intents (
      token_fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      account_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: ordinary_account_attempts
ordinary_attempts_schema_marker
quota_migration_marker
sql: CREATE TABLE quota_migration_marker (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1))

name: settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE settings (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: siwc_access_policy
sql:
CREATE TABLE siwc_access_policy (
        account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES siwc_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
        scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('all','selected'))
      )

name: siwc_access_users
sql:
CREATE TABLE siwc_access_users (
        account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES siwc_access_policy(account_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        PRIMARY KEY(account_id, user_id)
      )

name: siwc_authorization_intents
siwc_credentials
sql:
CREATE TABLE siwc_credentials (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, registration_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, credentials TEXT NOT NULL
    , revision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

name: siwc_refresh_claim_versions
siwc_resolved_refresh_intents
sql:
CREATE TABLE siwc_resolved_refresh_intents (
      token_fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    , result_revision TEXT)

name: siwc_routing_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE siwc_routing_settings (
        account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES siwc_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(priority)='integer' AND priority BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
        weight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(typeof(weight)='integer' AND weight BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
      )

name: siwc_usage_logs
sql:
CREATE TABLE siwc_usage_logs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES siwc_accounts(id), timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        model TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER,
        success INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(success IN (0,1)), aborted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(aborted IN (0,1)),
        status INTEGER, latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
      )

name: upstream_accounts
sql:
CREATE TABLE upstream_accounts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('anthropic', 'openai', 'google')),
  credential_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (credential_type IN ('cookie', 'api_key', 'session_token', 'oauth')),
  credentials TEXT NOT NULL,
  meta TEXT,
  quota_info TEXT,
  
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'quota_exceeded', 'error', 'disabled')),
  state_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  credential_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_refresh_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,
  last_used TIMESTAMP,
  last_error TEXT,
  
  daily_quota INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  used_today INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  quota_reset_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  
  priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  weight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
, request_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: usage_logs
sql:
CREATE TABLE usage_logs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  upstream_account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  
  timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  
  input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  
  success BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  error TEXT,
  
  latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (upstream_account_id) REFERENCES upstream_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: user_daily_quota
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_daily_quota (
        user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        day TEXT NOT NULL,
        used INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (used >= 0),
        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, day)
      )

name: users
sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  api_key_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('free', 'pro')),
  daily_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000,
  enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

name: protect_account_usage_history
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER protect_account_usage_history
        BEFORE DELETE ON upstream_accounts
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_logs WHERE upstream_account_id = OLD.id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'account has usage history'); END

name: protect_user_usage_history
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER protect_user_usage_history
        BEFORE DELETE ON users
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_logs WHERE user_id = OLD.id)
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_daily_quota WHERE user_id = OLD.id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'user has usage history'); END

name: upstream_credential_revision
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER upstream_credential_revision AFTER UPDATE OF credentials, credential_type ON upstream_accounts
        BEGIN UPDATE upstream_accounts SET credential_revision = credential_revision + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id; END

name: upstream_state_revision
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER upstream_state_revision AFTER UPDATE OF status, last_error ON upstream_accounts
        WHEN NEW.request_revision = OLD.request_revision
        BEGIN UPDATE upstream_accounts SET state_revision = state_revision + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id; END
